subject: clockwise, look for smoke stacks
author: oO EezO Oo
body:
Yeah, go around the quarry clockwise, up the hills etc.  You'll see two smoke stacks, there will be a break in the guard rails, fly off the road and aim so your car will fly to the left of the leftmost smoke stack.

CAPS LOCK - Cruise control for AWESOME!!

subject: you need to jump off the
author: alpinegagt
body: you need to jump off the ramp on the dirt road that wraps around the quarry. there are two ramps one when facing each direction. both go to a billboard, but one of them the billboard is real close and easy to see.
